$comment: THE committed exclusion list of specs/sor-site/surface/spec.md — one fact, one file. Consumed by BOTH tiers: tests/test_surface_contract.py (A2, source scan over shipped .ts/.tsx/.js/.css) and e2e/tests/static.spec.ts (B7, scan over built JS bundles). A pattern written as a bare string runs in both tiers, word-boundary and case-sensitive as written; an object entry narrows to one tier ('source' | 'bundle') and records why in its 'why'. The two files previously carried two hand-maintained copies and had diverged at birth (found 2026-08-13); do not add a pattern to one tier's consumer directly — add it here.

carveOuts.$comment: Spec A2: 'ReadingProgress carved out of any progress pattern' — the local scroll indicator is a kept content primitive. Both tiers scrub every occurrence of these tokens from the text before any pattern runs.

brand.$comment: De-brand (settled lead decision 2026-08-13): no upstream brand strings in shipped source or built output; branding comes from the consuming site's config. Case-insensitive so AgentFactory/agent-factory/AGENT_FACTORY cannot slip past a case-exact scan.
